notes.subject: מה דודך מדוד
notes.rationale: Question repeated twice word-for-word; the doubling frames the daughters' challenge and is kept intact.

notes.subject: ha-yafah ba-nashim
notes.rationale: Daughters of Jerusalem directly address the woman, demanding a description of her beloved.

translation: Wanem samting man bilong yu i gutpela long en, olsem long ol narapela man ol i laikim — yu, meri i gutpela tru namel long ol meri? Wanem man bilong yu i gutpela moa long ol narapela man i laikim, we yu swiaim mipela olsem?
